decisions.reason: The line moved from a mention to its own page in 2024, which signals growing commitment, and with its value still unfolding the option is worth keeping at low carrying cost.
The comfort insole is a cheap accessory still mentioned on the website, so it costs little to keep while its value remains uncertain, though it has gained no visibility.
The supportive insole is a low-cost item that complements the shoe range, so keeping it is cheap despite stagnant visibility and possible overlap with the flagship insole.
The ergonomic series has kept its own page in both years and fits the firm's innovation strategy, so there is no sign that the option has resolved negatively.
The firefighter boots gained their own page in 2024, which points to increasing commitment in a specialised segment with long product lifecycles.
The flagship moulded insole is on the home page in both years and has a concrete customer success with ALBA Braunschweig, showing that its value is being realized.
